dialogue.conversations.cat.personal.cour: Is there something you keep putting off?
dialogue.courage.respond: There's a thing I keep not doing.
dialogue.courage.respond.steady: You could do it. I'd not let you go at it alone.
dialogue.courage.respond.ask_what_stops_: What is it that stops you?
dialogue.courage.respond.admit_i_wouldnt: I've a list like that myself.
dialogue.courage.close.landed.hold_you_t: Then I'll ask you about it next week.
dialogue.courage.close.landed.leave: I'll get out of your way.
dialogue.courage.close.rebuffed.apologiz: That was clumsy of me. Sorry.
dialogue.courage.close.rebuffed.drop_it: Understood. I'll not bring it up.
dialogue.courage.open.first/1: There's a thing I've been meaning to do since spring, %1$s, and I've not done it.
dialogue.courage.open.first/2: I keep putting one job to the bottom of the list. It isn't a hard job. That's the part that galls me.
dialogue.courage.open.first/3: There's something I've not got round to. Not for want of time. I've had plenty of time.
dialogue.courage.open.wary/1: There's something I've not got round to. I'll not go into it.
dialogue.courage.open.wary/2: I've a thing I keep not doing. That's as much as you're getting, %1$s.
dialogue.courage.open.wary/3: There's a job I've been leaving. You needn't look at me like that.
dialogue.courage.open.again/1: Still the same thing I've not done. Nothing's changed since you asked.
dialogue.courage.open.again/2: You asked already. It's still sat there, undone.
dialogue.courage.open.again/3: The same job, still waiting. I've no better answer than last time.
dialogue.courage.steady.guard/1: That's a kind thing to offer from where you're standing. We're not there, you and I.
dialogue.courage.steady.guard/2: You'd not let me go alone. You barely know which house is mine.
dialogue.courage.steady.crit/1: Nobody's offered the second half of that before. Right. Sunday, then. Hold me to Sunday.
dialogue.courage.steady.crit/2: You mean the coming-with part, don't you. Then I've no excuse left. Ask me next week and I'll have done it.
dialogue.courage.steady.success/1: Aye. Aye, maybe I could. I'll think on it properly this time.
dialogue.courage.steady.success/2: That helps more than you'd guess. I'll not promise a day, but I'll go at it.
dialogue.courage.steady.partial/1: You mean well. It isn't the offer that's the trouble.
dialogue.courage.steady.partial/2: Maybe. I've said maybe before and it kept sitting there.
dialogue.courage.steady.rebuff/1: Don't push me at it. I know what it is I'm not doing.
dialogue.courage.steady.rebuff/2: I didn't ask for a shove, %1$s. Let it alone.
dialogue.courage.steady.plain/1: Aye, I could. Saying it out loud helps some.
dialogue.courage.steady.plain/2: You're right, and I know you're right. That's half the trouble.
dialogue.courage.steady.plain/3: I'll go at it. Don't ask me which day.
dialogue.courage.ask.reply/1: Nothing sensible. That's what galls. There's no reason in it.
dialogue.courage.ask.reply/2: If I had an answer I'd have fixed it. Every morning I just pick something else.
dialogue.courage.ask.reply/3: I've turned that over plenty. Honestly? I don't like how I'd look if it went wrong.
dialogue.courage.admit.reply/1: Everyone's got one. Doesn't make mine lighter, but it's decent of you to say.
dialogue.courage.admit.reply/2: Then you'll know it isn't laziness. People assume laziness.
dialogue.courage.admit.reply/3: Good. I'd have felt a fool being the only one.
dialogue.courage.leave/3: Go on. I'd best get back to it.
dialogue.courage.close.landed.hold/1: Do. I'll want the asking, I think.
dialogue.courage.close.landed.hold/2: Ask me. If nobody asks, it stays a thing I said once.
dialogue.courage.close.landed.hold/3: Then I'd best have something to tell you.
dialogue.courage.close.landed.easy/1: No. But there is a bit of one, and I put it there myself.
dialogue.courage.close.landed.easy/2: That's true, and it's also how the thing's stayed undone this long.
dialogue.courage.close.landed.easy/3: Kind of you. I'll try not to use it as a licence.
dialogue.courage.landed.parting/1: Right. Mind the step on your way.
dialogue.courage.landed.parting/2: Go on. I've said more than I meant to.
dialogue.courage.close.rebuffed.apology/: It was. But you meant it well, and I'm short today.
Accepted. Don't do it again this week and we're square.
Aye. I'd rather be asked than pushed, that's all.
dialogue.courage.close.rebuffed.dropped/: Good. I'll bring it up myself when there's something to say.
Thank you. It's mine to carry until it isn't.
That's the right answer. I'll not forget you gave it.
